title: Nonverbal Communication: Types, Indian Cues and the 7-38-55 Myth Explained
seoTitle: Nonverbal Communication: Types, Examples and Myths
seoDescription: Nonverbal communication is face, tone, gestures, eye contact, touch and space. See the types, Indian cues like the head wobble and what research disproves.
excerpt: What the 1967 Mehrabian studies really measured, a table of every type of nonverbal cue, Indian gestures that often get misread, and why lie-spotting and power poses don't hold up in research.
